articles.summary: LOS GATOS, Calif., November 9, 2026 — Tigo Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: TYGO) (“Tigo” or “Company”), a leading provider of intelligent solar and energy software solutions, today announced a significant expansion of virtual power plant (VPP) and battery incentive program access for customers using the Tigo GO Battery. Building on previously announced programs in Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, and Puerto Rico, eligible Tigo customers can now access additional programs in California, Texas, select PJM territories, and New York. The expansion gives homeowners more ways to use stored energy beyond backup power and self-consumption. Depending on local program requirements, eligible systems can participate in programs that reward flexible energy use, support grid reliability, and create additional opportunities to realize value from residential energy storage.
articles.title: Tigo Energy VPP Boosts Storage Economics for Installers to Provide Homeowner Savings

articles.summary: LOS GATOS, Calif., November 12, 2026 — Tigo Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: TYGO) (“Tigo” or “Company”), a leading provider of intelligent solar and energy software solutions, today announced a collaboration with Google Cloud to develop AI-enabled operational workflows for solar installers and distributed energy portfolios. By making core Tigo data and software products available through Google Cloud, Tigo aims to deliver faster deployment, simplified data integration, and additional insights with Gemini. The resulting workflows will help installers, asset managers, and energy operators more easily identify issues, prioritize actions, and automate routine operational tasks across growing fleets of distributed energy systems.
articles.title: Tigo Energy and Google Cloud Pair AI-Powered Tools for Solar Installers and Utilities
